questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That it was a english spoken country and that it was outside of Europe.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was a fantastic experience and i am grateful that i went on Exchange for a semester.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was okay. There where many thing you had to do before arriving.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I was in contact with my home faculty about some courses.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: I did not use it that much.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I used AirBnb to find housing. It took some time to find something i could afford. But it was a great experience, because I lived with other student from the same University that i was studying at.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Transportation to campus. I had to take two busses to get to the campus, so it took some time.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: There where not that many opportunities/places to live at campus. I ended on a waiting list so i had to find housing off campus.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It took a lot of time and i took a while before you got the confirmation in the end.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was a long process that took a lot of time. But it was not too difficult to do the registration.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There where a exchange office you could contact if you had any questions.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes i wanted. So it was great. But there where some classes that i wanted to take in the beginning which I found out that I could not take in the Fall semester.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Begin early and be prepared to use some time on it because it is a long process that takes som time.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I was very good. I had some good professors.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level was kind of the same as at my home university so it was fine.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was just lectures. I did not have any tutorials as what i am used to at UCPH.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

Great campus

questions.answer: Meeting new people from other countries and other cultures. I was very nice.
